long_biography.plain_text:
Malhas entered business through his family's catering operation in Amman after studying economics at the American University of Beirut. He broadened the platform by opening a semi-wholesale supermarket and ice-cream factory, then developed airline catering services. The commercial network later expanded into motor distribution, hotels and banking, making his wealth diversified rather than traceable to one employer or investment fund.

His career combined management with direct share ownership. He led Al Mahmoudia Trading and its automotive activities, became a founding shareholder of a Saudi bank and invested in hotel companies. He is now a board member of Mediterranean Tourism Investments, associated with the Four Seasons Hotel in Amman. He holds shares in his own name, while Mahmoud Malhas Property Ltd holds a much larger position. That named-company holding is not treated as personal cash or sole ownership without separate control evidence. Former bank board positions likewise do not make bank assets his property, and the complete composition of his current personal holdings remains undisclosed.
